## Proof

The function is bounded: if not, take $x_n$ with $|f(x_n)| > n$ and use [[Bolzano-Weierstrass|5XGYQ6]]. Let $M = \sup f$. Take $x_n$ with $f(x_n) \to M$, and a convergent subsequence. Continuity gives the maximum.
